label: Ventilation Settings
definition: Mechanical ventilation parameters and configurations, recorded as part of intensive care management data in the BrainIT database.

label: Cerebral Perfusion Pressure (CPP) Insult
definition: A secondary insult defined by CPP falling below a critical threshold, such as 70 mmHg or 60 mmHg.

label: Intracranial Pressure (ICP) Monitoring
definition: The clinical procedure of measuring pressure inside the cranium, with variations in site (intraventricular, intraparenchymal, subdural) and technology.

label: Observation Value
definition: The value produced by a sensing process, represented in the semantic sensor network ontology as a superclass of reading.

label: Jugular Venous Oxygen Saturation
definition: An additional physiological monitoring parameter measuring oxygen saturation in jugular venous blood, recorded in the BrainIT database if monitored as part of clinical management.

label: Treatment
definition: A clinical intervention administered to a patient, such as noradrenaline or adrenaline.

label: Observation Collection
definition: A collection of observations associated with a specific timepoint, represented as a superclass of timepoint in the medical observations ontology.

label: Pupil Responsiveness
definition: A clinical assessment parameter recording the reactivity of the pupil, classified as reacting or un-reacting in the BrainIT dataset.

label: Outcome Factor
definition: A data element indicating the most important factor influencing patient outcome, such as head injury or other illness, collected in the BrainIT dataset.

label: Brain Monitoring
definition: The continuous measurement of physiological parameters in brain-injured patients to guide care.

label: Clinical Utility
definition: Practical value and effectiveness of medical interventions in patient care.

label: Intensive Care Unit
definition: A hospital unit providing intensive treatment and monitoring for critically ill patients, generating large volumes of patient data used in medical research.

label: Patient Data
definition: Data recorded from patients, including monitoring data, used for medical decision making and offline analysis.

label: Outcome Data
definition: A category of clinical information measuring the results or recovery status of patients following intensive care management.

label: Brain Injury
definition: A clinical condition involving damage to the brain, which is the focus of data collection and management in the BrainIT network.

label: Arterial Pressure Measurement
definition: The measurement of blood pressure, typically using fluid-filled catheter-transducer systems where damping is a factor.

label: Sensor Accuracy
definition: The precision of a monitoring device, defined as a +/- value or percentage, used in data validation rules.

label: Pharmacological Therapy
definition: Drug-based treatment, specifically referenced in the context of Phase II clinical trials.

label: Arterial Oxygen Saturation
definition: A core physiological monitoring parameter measuring arterial oxygen saturation via pulse oximetry, recorded in the BrainIT database.

label: Neurological Outcome
definition: A measure of the patient's neurological recovery or result following injury and treatment.

label: Blood Pressure (BP) Transducer
definition: A medical device used to convert blood pressure into an electrical signal, with zero reference site location being a source of error.

label: High-resolution Monitoring
definition: Minute-by-minute collection of physiological data to capture detailed trends in patient status.

label: Treatment Data
definition: A category of clinical information documenting therapeutic interventions administered to patients in the intensive care unit.

label: Routine Nursing
definition: Coded fields annotating routine nursing interventions such as eye and mouth care, endotracheal tube suction, and bed care, recorded in the BrainIT database.

label: Medical Disorder
definition: A clinical condition such as hypertension or hypotension, used in rules to reclassify data errors based on symptoms.

label: Neurological Injury
definition: A medical history condition involving previous injury to the nervous system, identified as part of patient history in the BrainIT dataset.

label: Physiological Parameter
definition: A monitored variable such as blood pressure or heart rate, collected as time series data from ICU patient monitoring equipment.

label: Non-monitoring Data
definition: Core dataset elements that are not continuous physiological measurements, such as management or demographic information.

label: Monitoring
definition: The clinical approach or protocol for observing patients, which can be tested in trials within the BrainIT network.

label: Transcranial Doppler
definition: An additional physiological monitoring technique using ultrasonography to assess cerebral blood flow velocity, recorded in the BrainIT database if monitored as part of clinical management.

label: Blood Brain Barrier
definition: Physiological barrier regulating passage of substances from blood to brain tissue.

label: Sensing Process
definition: A process implemented by a sensor to observe properties, defined in the semantic sensor network ontology.

label: Management
definition: The clinical approach or protocol for caring for patients, which can be tested in trials within the BrainIT network.

label: Non-Invasive Blood Pressure
definition: Non-invasive blood pressure monitoring, an optional BrainIT parameter.

label: Neuromonitoring
definition: Continuous measurement of neurological physiological parameters.

label: Management Data
definition: Information on clinical care and treatment practices collected from patients in neurointensive care.

label: Prospective Trial
definition: A forward-looking clinical study designed to test the effectiveness of data collection procedures and estimate error rates.

label: Brain Tissue Oxygen
definition: An additional physiological monitoring parameter measuring partial pressure of oxygen in brain tissue, recorded in the BrainIT database if monitored as part of clinical management.

label: Substance Abuse
definition: A medical history condition involving misuse of substances, identified as part of patient history in the BrainIT dataset.

label: Computed Tomography Scan
definition: A diagnostic imaging procedure used to assess brain injury, with data collected on worst findings and classification in the BrainIT dataset.

label: Neurointensive Care
definition: Specialized intensive care for patients with neurological injuries, involving advanced monitoring and management.

label: General Medical Icu
definition: An intensive care unit treating a broad range of medical conditions, as opposed to specialized units like traumatic brain injury ICU.

label: Traumatic Brain Injury
definition: A clinical condition involving brain damage caused by an external force, the primary patient population studied by the BrainIT group.

label: Suctioning
definition: A nursing intervention involving clearing secretions from the airway, performed regularly as part of patient care in the BrainIT dataset.

label: Central Venous Pressure
definition: An additional physiological monitoring parameter measuring pressure in the thoracic vena cava, recorded in the BrainIT database if monitored as part of clinical management.

label: Head Injury
definition: A clinical condition involving trauma to the head, specifically referenced in the context of patient data collection for the BrainIT dataset.

label: Data
definition: Information collected from research studies and stored in the database, categorized as validated or not validated.

label: Hydrostatic Pressure Gradient
definition: Pressure difference caused by fluid column height between head and heart.

label: Main Lesion
definition: A CT scan finding category indicating the primary injury type, such as subdural or extradural, recorded in the BrainIT dataset.

label: Sex
definition: A demographic data element recorded for patient information in the BrainIT dataset.

label: Machine
definition: A platform housing sensors used in medical evaluation, represented as a subclass of platform in the medical machine/sensor ontology.

label: Cistern State
definition: A CT scan assessment parameter noting the condition of brain cisterns as present, compressed, or absent in the BrainIT dataset.

label: Admission Data
definition: A category of clinical information collected upon patient entry into the intensive care unit, part of the BrainIT standardized dataset.

label: Measurement Capability
definition: The capability of a sensor to perform measurements, described in the semantic sensor network ontology.

label: Acceptable Range
definition: The predefined minimum and maximum values for a physiological parameter, used to identify data errors in ICU monitoring.

label: Stratification Design
definition: Clinical trial methodology grouping patients by specific characteristics.

label: End-Tidal Carbon Dioxide
definition: An additional physiological monitoring parameter measuring end-tidal carbon dioxide concentration, recorded in the BrainIT database if monitored as part of clinical management.

label: Reading
definition: A recorded observation value linked to a parameter and sensor, represented as a subclass of observation value in the patient data ontology.

label: Property
definition: A characteristic or attribute that can be observed, represented as a superclass of parameter in the semantic sensor network ontology.

label: Case Report Form (CRF)
definition: A data collection form used in clinical research for recording adverse events and other trial data.

label: Confounding Factor
definition: Variable that influences both dependent and independent variables in clinical research.

label: Traumatic Coma Databank Classification
definition: A classification system for traumatic brain injury based on CT scan findings, used in the BrainIT dataset to categorize lesions.

label: Age
definition: A demographic data element recorded as an absolute decimal number for patient anonymity in the BrainIT dataset.
